n, k, mod = map(int, input().split())

def fast_pow(base, exp):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

if n % 2 == 1:
    print(fast_pow(k, n))
else:
    factorial = [1] * (n + 1)
    inv_factorial = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        factorial[i] = factorial[i - 1] * i % mod
    inv_factorial[n] = fast_pow(factorial[n], mod - 2)
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        inv_factorial[i] = inv_factorial[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod

    bits = []
    for i in range(n):
        if n & (1 << i):
            bits.append(i)

    segment_lengths = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(n + 1):
        j = i
        while j != 0:
            segment_lengths[i] += 1
            j = (j - 1) & j

    visited = [False] * (1 << n)
    for mask in range((1 << n) - 1, -1, -1):
        if mask == 0:
            break
        visited[mask] = True

    dp = [[0] * (1 << n) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp[0][0] = 1

    for mask in range(1 << n):
        for s in range(n + 1):
            if dp[s][mask] == 0:
                continue
            sub_mask = mask
            while sub_mask:
                sub_mask = (sub_mask - 1) & mask
                l = min(k, segment_lengths[mask ^ sub_mask] + 1)
                for s2 in range(1, l + 1):
                    if s2 <= s and dp[s - 1][mask ^ sub_mask]:
                        dp[s][mask] = (dp[s][mask] + dp[s - 1][mask ^ sub_mask] * inv_factorial[sub_mask]) % mod

    total = 0
    full_mask = (1 << n) - 1
    for i in range(min(k, segment_lengths[n]) + 1):
        if dp[i][full_mask]:
            val = dp[i][full_mask] * factorial[k] % mod
            val = val * inv_factorial[k - i] % mod
            val = val * inv_factorial[i] % mod
            val = val * factorial[n] % mod
            total = (total + val) % mod

    print((fast_pow(k, n) - total + mod) % mod)
